title: Pay the native gradient and global curvature before invoking mixing
statement: Slice contraction sandwiches bound native product derivatives without a topology or hopping-bandwidth multiplier. Prefix/suffix products acquire the complete determinant gradient; chi<1 makes every interpolating field action strongly convex. Gaussian-start/discrete-path KL and bounded annealing ratios supply the stated sampler/normalizer interfaces without an oracle.
